answer: Sybil farms thrive when a new name is cheaper than honest work. Our gate is a delayed reveal: a recruit posts a cipher of a work transcript, then freezes a bonded stake in a tundra reserve for five epochs before any vote weight appears on the marble roll. A second name needs another reserve and another wait; a reused transcript is rejected because it binds the address and a one-time ticket id. Auditors recompute hashes from the public roll and slash a mute reserve. Colluding clerks can still stamp clones, so they are resampled from disjoint cohorts and each may sign only two tickets per epoch.
